label: rem:MAPDEP_metric
title: Remark
body_md:
\label{rem:MAPDEP_metric}
	Equation \eqref{eq:MAPDEP} shows that, after adopting the optimal MAP detector, the minimum detection error probability depends on the local quantizers only through the induced conditional distributions $p(\mathbf{u}|H_0)$ and $p(\mathbf{u}|H_1)$. Therefore, the detector need not be optimized separately, and $P_E(H,\mathbf{u})$ provides an exact finite-sensor objective for quantizer design.

label: rem:multibit_surrogate_scope
title: Remark
body_md:
\label{rem:multibit_surrogate_scope}
	Equation \eqref{eq:multibit_loss} provides a computationally tractable Bhattacharyya design objective whose evaluation is linear in the number of quantization levels. Its optimized Chernoff counterpart characterizes the asymptotic Bayesian error exponent, and \eqref{eq:multibit_loss} attains the same exponent when $\lambda^*=1/2$. At finite $K$, it serves as an upper-bound surrogate rather than the exact MAP error.
